title: DLSS 5: Real-Time Generative Rendering
abstract: 本文提出 DLSS 5：一种面向交互式图形的实时生成式渲染阶段。它以游戏引擎渲染的 RGB 帧为主要条件，结合运动向量、跨帧状态和艺术指导，通过训练时的反照率、表面法线与光照一致性监督，学习来自真实照片的外观先验。系统采用紧凑的一步像素空间扩散模型与因果逐帧流式推理，在保持开发者创作内容、结构和身份的同时增强材质与光照外观，并在 GeForce RTX 50 系列上支持最高 4K 实时渲染。
abstractOriginal: We present DLSS 5, a real-time generative rendering stage for interactive graphics that complements conventional rendering with appearance priors learned from real-world visual data. DLSS 5 uses a one-step pixel-space diffusion model conditioned on the current rendered frame, engine motion vectors, carried temporal state, and artistic-direction values. Renderer-derived albedo, surface-normal, and lighting signals provide consistency supervision during training so that the model can enhance materials and illumination while preserving authored content and design intent. The resulting causal, deterministic, frame-wise system operates under a strict per-frame compute budget and supports real-time rendering up to 4K on GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs.
methodologicalComplexity: Novel architecture with grounded training, one-step diffusion, and causal streaming
